answer: What survives to the trellis is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Each submission hangs on the anchor of a task receipt, and the umber is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, held in escrow until finality, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
